reply.text: {"options":[{"name":"Greek Yogurt Berry Oat Bowl","why":"no stove needed and quick to put together","cuisine":"American","method":"bowl","minutes":5,"servings":1,"mealType":"breakfast","ingredients":[{"text":"200 g plain Greek yogurt","quantity":200,"unit":"g","food":"greek yogurt"},{"text":"40 g rolled oats","quantity":40,"unit":"g","food":"rolled oats"},{"text":"80 g blueberries","quantity":80,"unit":"g","food":"blueberries"},{"text":"15 g almonds, roughly chopped","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"almonds"},{"text":"10 g honey","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"honey"},{"text":"1 pinch ground cinnamon","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"ground cinnamon"}],"steps":["Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.","Stir in the dry rolled oats and a pinch of cinnamon.","Top with blueberries and chopped almonds.","Drizzle with honey and eat right away, or chill 10 minutes for a softer oat texture."]},{"name":"Savory Tofu Scramble Wrap","why":"high protein without eggs, and it comes together in one pan","cuisine":"Mexican","method":"pan","minutes":15,"servings":1,"mealType":"breakfast","ingredients":[{"text":"150 g firm tofu, drained and crumbled","quantity":150,"unit":"g","food":"firm tofu"},{"text":"1 low-carb tortilla","quantity":40,"unit":"g","food":"low-carb tortilla"},{"text":"50 g baby spinach","quantity":50,"unit":"g","food":"baby spinach"},{"text":"60 g red bell pepper, diced","quantity":60,"unit":"g","food":"red bell pepper"},{"text":"10 g olive oil","quantity":10,"unit":"g","food":"olive oil"},{"text":"30 g salsa","quantity":30,"unit":"g","food":"salsa"},{"text":"1/2 tsp cumin","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"cumin"},{"text":"salt and pepper to taste","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"salt"}],"steps":["Heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.","Cook the diced bell pepper for 3 minutes until softened.","Add the crumbled tofu, cumin, salt and pepper; cook 5 minutes, stirring, until lightly golden.","Stir in the spinach until just wilted, about 1 minute.","Warm the tortilla for 20 seconds in the pan or a microwave.","Fill the tortilla with the tofu mix, add salsa, and roll it up."]},{"name":"Cottage Cheese Peanut Butter Toast","why":"fastest of the three and no cooking at all","cuisine":"American","method":"no-cook","minutes":5,"servings":1,"mealType":"breakfast","ingredients":[{"text":"2 slices whole-wheat bread, toasted","quantity":70,"unit":"g","food":"whole-wheat bread"},{"text":"150 g cottage cheese","quantity":150,"unit":"g","food":"cottage cheese"},{"text":"15 g peanut butter","quantity":15,"unit":"g","food":"peanut butter"},{"text":"1 sliced banana","quantity":100,"unit":"g","food":"banana"},{"text":"1 pinch ground cinnamon","quantity":null,"unit":"","food":"ground cinnamon"}],"steps":["Toast the bread until golden and crisp.","Spread the peanut butter thinly over both slices.","Pile cottage cheese on top and spread it out.","Layer on the banana slices and dust with cinnamon."]}]}
